prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original production reference image for a 3D winter conifer asset for URMAN. Input 1 is our own existing game screenshot: use the central timber house as the MATERIAL AND RENDERING FAMILY reference (weathered tactile surfaces, restrained believable detail, soft winter sunlight). Input 2 is the existing game pine asset as a FUNCTIONAL form reference only: upright single tree, straight narrow visible lower bole with small dead branches, crown occupying upper 58 percent, base at ground. Redesign its coarse folded flat fans into a believable mature winter pine with irregular layered boughs, finely broken needle silhouettes grouped in substantial connected clusters, restrained snow settled only on upper surfaces, warm grey-brown fissured bark and muted deep blue-green needles. Keep a slender bole and airy spaces between asymmetrical branches; no giant Christmas-tree bottom skirt, no broad roots. Full tree, three-quarter view, complete base and tip, no cropping, centered and large in frame, neutral even studio lighting, muted light grey background. This is a material-rich real-time 3D game asset matching the house, neither photographic scanning nor a cartoon toy; small convincing detail with clear large shapes. No environment, ground plane, pot, people, labels, watermark or cast scene shadows. Show exactly one tree, not a sheet of views. The snow, bark and needles should be spatially distinct. Do not reproduce the old coarse triangular blade silhouette.
